Walk that order greedily: before adding a member, close the open chunk if it already holds 5 members or if the union of lock keys would exceed 15; the member then opens a new chunk. Drop chunks of one. Recipe groups are emitted in order of first encounter scanning ascending task_id; that affects only CSV row order, not the pack set. a2: groups keyed (parent, kind), iterated by their smallest task_id; union-find on shared non-hub keys; each component chunked greedily in ascending task_id under the same close rule; singletons dropped.
